classify.action: List 4–6 items related to {interest}. Sort them into two groups by your own rule and name each group.
classify.title: Sort into groups
compare.action: Pick two examples related to {interest}. Write one thing that is the same and one that differs.
compare.title: Compare two things
dirAdd: Virtual new handoff: add a direction
directionConflict: A direction change must be sent as a new handoff marked add or switch.
emptyField: Write the question and scope, or use the suggestion.
expired: This suggestion is from an earlier day or an older handoff. Get today's suggestion again.
intro: Use the strengths, interests and direction you confirmed in LAB to try one 5–10 minute practice a day. You do not need to go back to LAB.
invalid: The LAB daily practice records do not match.
invalidHandoff: This handoff has an invalid format or content.
jobPending: The job LAB sender contract is still being confirmed, so it cannot be received here. It is not assumed to match the youth LAB contract.
kindNote: This is a daily practice, not a real work experience or a simulation record. It is not turned into a career claim automatically.
limit: No more can be added today.
limitNote: The daily limit here is a local demonstration. A real limit needs one server-checked count per login across LABs, tabs and devices.
mixed.action: For {interest}: observe, compare, classify, plan one step, then look back, one line each.
mixed.title: One loop of five steps
needFirst: Get the first suggestion before asking for more.
noMore: There are no more different suggestions for today.
notConnected: A real LAB handoff is not connected yet. Only the virtual demo handoff can be received here.
observe.action: Choose one thing related to {interest} and look at it for 2 minutes. Write 3 facts you noticed.
observe.title: Observe one thing
optionalNote: Optional. Skipping has no penalty or judgment.
plan.action: Choose one small step toward {direction}. Write when, where and what you will do first.
plan.title: Plan one small step
question: Question to ask yourself
reflect.action: Recall something you did or learned about {interest} today. Write what you would keep or change next time.
reflect.title: Look back on one thing
requestConflict: This request ID was already used for different content.
scopeText: Practice for {direction} with {interest}: observe, compare, classify, plan and reflect, one short line each.
stageMismatch: The education stage in the handoff differs from the stage confirmed on this account, so it was not accepted.
staleHandoff: An older or conflicting handoff cannot replace a newer one.
supportNote: The support style only changes how information is shown. It is not a score, diagnosis or proof of effect.
title: Daily career practice from LAB
virtual: Virtual handoff demo. This is not a real LAB connection and nothing is verified by a server.
